games.title: Magic Shot
games.one_line: A magical liquid-sorting puzzle: pour glowing potions between enchanted bottles until every bottle holds one colour.

games.title: Aetherhold
games.one_line: Build a kingdom on a floating sky island, summon heroes, raise an army and battle through a 30-stage campaign.

games.title: Ashgrove Extraction
games.one_line: A third-person survival shooter: find Mara in a militia-held town, keep her alive, call for help and reach the evac helicopter.

games.title: Cargo Climb
games.one_line: A hill-climb driving game where you haul three loose crates over the hills and get paid for every crate that reaches a depot.

games.title: Chroma Clash
games.one_line: A funky 3D color-matching card game: play bots, friends on one phone, or friends anywhere online.

games.title: Arrow Rush
games.one_line: Clear every arrow off the board without a collision. 100 classic levels and 10 adventure worlds.

games.title: Mystery Island
games.one_line: Explore five islands, solve puzzles and mini-games, and collect the map pieces that unlock the treasure.

games.title: Fight for Right
games.one_line: Fly a fighter squadron at 35,000 ft over a whole country while SAM bases and hidden launchers fire missiles at you.

games.title: Bridge Genius: Setu Builders
games.one_line: Build real-physics bridges, railways and signals across India, and earn your building money by learning.

games.title: Domino Game
games.one_line: Trace, topple magic dominoes and sing along: ABC, Hindi and Bangla letters, 65 rhymes, numbers, animals, India, road safety and more, Nursery to Class 7, with English, Hindi or Bangla voice.

games.title: Ecos-Synthetica

games.title: Survival

games.title: Skyfall Armada
games.one_line: Command a flying warship, destroy enemy fleets, and rule the skies in fast-paced aerial battles.

games.title: Echo Island
games.one_line: Explore a living island, bond with creatures and rebuild its lost memory, where every choice changes the world.

games.title: Babel Harbour

games.title: BrainRush Daily

games.title: Island Match Quest

games.title: Racing Mania
games.one_line: Dodge oncoming traffic across three lanes and rack up distance before you crash.

games.title: COPROB

games.title: Dino Frontier

games.title: BLOXPLODE

games.title: Arrow Puzzle
games.one_line: Every arrow points somewhere. Clear the board without a collision.

games.title: House Mafia
games.one_line: Mafia and Werewolf, set at a house party. 4 to 8 players, 3 to 5 minute rounds.

games.title: Word Quest
games.one_line: Drag across the grid, find the words, win the minute.
